sloka: हिमान्ते पश्य सौमित्रे वृक्षाणाम् पुष्प संभवम् ।पुष्प मासे हि तरवः संघर्षात् इव पुष्पिताः ॥४-१-९१॥
transliteration: himānte paśya saumitre vṛkṣāṇām puṣpa saṁbhavam ।puṣpa māse hi taravaḥ saṁgharṣāt iva puṣpitāḥ ॥4-1-91॥

translations.english: 'Winter has ended and the season of flowers has set in, O Saumitri The trees are full of flowers as if competing with one another.
